questions.problem: If the sum of the first $32$ terms of an arithmetic series is ${S}_{32}=648,$ and the last term is ${a}_{32}=37.3,$ then the first term of the series is ${a}_{1}=${{field-1}}.
questions.worked_solution:
We are given the last term of our series. So, to find the first term, we use the formula for the sum of an arithmetic series in the form

$$
{S}_{N}=\frac{N}{2}({a}_{1}+{a}_{N}),
$$

where ${a}_{1}$ is the first term, ${a}_{N}$ is the last term, and $N$ is the number of terms.

Substituting ${a}_{32}=37.3$, $N=32$, and ${S}_{N}=648$ into the formula above and solving for ${a}_{1}$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}648 & =\frac{32}{2}({a}_{1}+37.3) \\ 648 & =16({a}_{1}+37.3) \\ \frac{648}{16} & ={a}_{1}+37.3 \\ 40.5 & ={a}_{1}+37.3 \\ {a}_{1} & =3.2.\end{aligned}
$$
